# BookiScout - Croatia Travel & Accommodation Guide
# https://bookiscout.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-03-29

## About
BookiScout is a comprehensive travel guide for Croatia, providing detailed information about apartments, beaches, restaurants, and attractions across all Croatian destinations.

## Content Structure
- /guides/{destination}-{theme} - Detailed decision guides (apartments, beaches, family, budget, food, etc.)
- /destinations/{destination} - Destination overviews with key stats
- /stay-check - Free accommodation area analyzer tool (see Stay Check section below)
- /stay-check/{destination} - Pre-analyzed area reviews with scores, beaches, restaurants, noise, walkability
- /about - About BookiScout
- /contact - Contact information
- /privacy - Privacy policy
- /terms - Terms of service

## Stay Check — Accommodation Area Analyzer
Stay Check is a free tool that analyzes the neighborhood around any accommodation in Croatia.

How it works:
1. User pastes a Booking.com, Airbnb, or Apartmanija.hr link
2. We geocode the location and find all nearby places within 1.5km via Google Places API
3. We analyze real Google Maps reviews from nearby restaurants, beaches, cafes, bars, parking, supermarkets
4. AI generates a personalized report with scores, pros/cons, risks, and alternatives

Data provided per area review:
- Overall area score (0-100) and per-category scores
- Guest type scores: families, couples, groups, solo travelers, digital nomads
- Beach report: type (pebble/sand/rocky), water entry, kid safety, crowding, facilities
- Restaurant & bar recommendations with real review quotes and prices in EUR
- Walkability assessment with distances to key amenities in meters
- Noise level assessment based on guest experiences
- Daily budget estimate (low-high range in EUR)
- Seasonal advice (best months, crowds, water temperature)
- Accessibility report (wheelchair, terrain, beach access)
- Family safety notes (playgrounds, doctors, pharmacies with distances)
- Alternative nearby areas with booking search links

Supported platforms: Booking.com, Airbnb, Apartmanija.hr, Laganini.hr
Available in all 13 languages listed below.

## Popular Destinations
- Split - Dalmatian coast city
- Dubrovnik - Historic walled city
- Zagreb - Capital city
- Zadar - Roman ruins and sea organ
- Pula - Istrian peninsula, Roman arena
- Rovinj - Picturesque Istrian town
- Hvar - Popular island destination
- Plitvice Lakes - UNESCO National Park

## Data Format
All pages include:
- Structured data (Schema.org): WebApplication, Review, TouristDestination, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList
- FAQ sections with real data-backed answers
- Price information in EUR (from real guest reviews)
- Distance measurements in meters/km
- Area scores on 0-100 scale
- Google Maps links to all mentioned places (restaurants, bars, beaches, attractions)
